intent: Make crop catalog mapping source the ingredient identifier and ingredient name from one explicit linked Ingredient reference.
rationale: Bind crop.getIngredient() once before constructing CropResponse, then map ingredientId and ingredientName from that linked Ingredient while leaving the crop name, growth duration, and yield mapping unchanged.
public_checks: Inspected CatalogServiceTest mapping expectations and CropResponse component order in the supplied parent.
Public guard attempted with the supplied Maven wrapper; it could not run because the Maven distribution was not included in the bundle and bundle-only execution forbids fetching it.
uncertainties: The full public Maven guard could not execute offline because the wrapper distribution was absent from the bundle.

The supplied parent already dereferenced crop.getIngredient().getName(); no reserved evaluator was available, so the patch makes the linked Ingredient binding explicit without changing intended mapping semantics.
